name: magnet.lead
description: Lead-magnet quality for a B2B service (Taki MicroMagnet rules plus conversion practice): splinter naming, two-minute value, a delivered result, fair friction, the next step baked in at the point of need, vertical variants, shareability, proof of method, honesty and discoverability. Input is an evidence dossier of the magnet's observable facts.

lm_splinter_name.instructions: Is the magnet named as a specific splinter outcome rather than a broad topic? (family J, weight 2)
criteria: The name alone tells the buyer the exact result they get

lm_fast_consumption.instructions: Can the buyer get value in about two minutes per step without reading a long article? (family J, weight 2)

lm_outcome_delivered.instructions: Does the magnet deliver a usable result (a diagnosis, a score, a plan), not just information? (family J, weight 3)
criteria: A result the buyer would pay for

lm_friction_fairness.instructions: Is access friction fair to the value (ungated, or a fair, disclosed exchange)? (family J, weight 2)
criteria: Zero friction, explicit data boundary, full value

lm_next_step_baked.instructions: Is the next step (review or build) built into the result at the point of need rather than a footer call to action? (family J, weight 3)
criteria: Call to action after the result
Call to action tied to the result
Per-failure next step with its cost
Plus fit guidance (when not to buy)
Inline, per-failure, priced, honest next step

lm_vertical_variant.instructions: Does the magnet speak to specific verticals (examples, native language) rather than generic businesses? (family J, weight 2)
criteria: Each vertical gets its own native version

lm_shareable.instructions: Can the buyer forward the result to a partner or decision-maker (print, export, link)? (family J, weight 1)

lm_method_proof.instructions: Does the magnet demonstrate the seller's method and expertise while being useful on its own? (family J, weight 2)
criteria: The method is the product sample
Unmistakable proof the seller knows this cold

lm_honesty.instructions: Does the magnet avoid manipulative framing and tell the buyer when they do not need to buy? (family J, weight 1)

lm_discoverability.instructions: Is the magnet easy to reach from the site and ads (prominent, one click)? (family J, weight 1)
criteria: Primary call to action and ad sitelink
The obvious first step from every entry

lm_continuation_path.instructions: After value is delivered, is there a consented, useful way to continue (save results, full kit, reply to a human)? (family J, weight 1)
criteria: Consented follow-up and a human reply
Plus the result carried into the inquiry
Seamless consented continuation that carries the result

rules.reason: magnet delivers information, not a result
